contentPattern: cmp-prescripcion swiper: 4 interest profiles (How about some / sophistication; Lead me to the / urban pulse; Show me around / I'm new here; I'm open to / suggestions) with arquetip-* illustrations | Interactive swiper of 4 profile tiles (approved mapping cmp-prescripcion -> carousel-interests). Labels are paragraphs (eyebrow + label), not headings.

cells: Eyebrow paragraph (e.g. 'How about some') + label paragraph (e.g. 'sophistication')

usage: One row per tile: illustration image | eyebrow paragraph + label paragraph. Prev/next arrows scroll the tiles. A single link in the text cell makes the whole tile clickable.
reuseGuidance: Use for short rows of illustrated choice tiles. For full-width slides with headings and CTAs, use carousel.
